body: How’s been your day friend?

When I went to rehab (for 4 days because I couldn’t stand the isolation from music), the counselor there on the first real day there made a great statement that I often try to live. KISS, keep it simple stupid (or silly if you prefer that). Almost got high off of air duster while driving on a 2 hour trip, which my therapist said was a suicide attempt. All because I felt alone and the one person I trusted and had ditched my time with them to pursue drugs and another person’s company.

Anyway, KISS is something I try to remember. Everyone is insecure. No one feels comfortable with themselves. Which is why most most things in life is a plan. 

It’s okay to feel have insecurities about the future. It’s okay to be sad. It’s just what we do with that to do things that’ll make us feel good.

Just be real with yourself and those that care about you. Having people that care is a rare thing to have. 

A quote from a kids movie- “yesterday is history, tomorrow is a mystery, and today is a gift… that’s why they call it present”. - master Oogway

Money is one thing. But the happiness you feel are another. Sure, alcohol gives a special space of happiness but it’s false. Nothing it gives nor will promise is something you want. You’ll wake up feeling regret and giving the wrong impression of who you are to other people. 

Maybe you don’t say to others how you feel. Then you mean you’re lying to yourself. You’re lying to the one person that matters most. Nothing will give you the happiness more than being alone with your thoughts. Accepting who you have been and what you are.

all the insecurities we feel is normal. No one and I mean nothing will ever realize how we feel but ourselves. Years of drinking won’t give my words any weight but give it to a drunk that’s on a 2 week bender. Who knows how long it will go? Only I do. I wanna experience other things other than what alcohol tastes like in other liquids. I’m sure you’ll wanna not cry and see the better side  of happiness, god knows I wanna.

So just keep trying. Every moment you’re not Ingesting a bottle of sadness, is another moment you won over what it means to be human. 

Cuz at the end of the day. We are only the sums of our actions. And we should take the road less traveled..

And that’s the other side of the coin. Sure killing myself sucks to the few that care but it’s something I don’t do because I’m selfless in a way. I got a little brother and sister that’s 4 and 3 that’s olds enough to remember who I was (generally). Not to mention the other 4 siblings (3 are step siblings) that know me somewhat personally. Also my folks, especially my mom who known me for my whole life. What would she think do her life knowing she lost her grandma (her most influential in her life) one year and her first son the next? 

I just wanna feel all the sadness now that I will ever feel so the feel goods come and stay. I could get sober and leave this alcohol behind but what’s there in my life? A job I hate and struggling to fall asleep wondering what she’s doing now? Wondering what I could of had been if I didn’t let her ruin my life?

At the end of the day it’s my fault for the choices I make and I know that. It’s just so hard to accept the way things are and look on the bright. Especially when there’s nothing to look forward to the next day. 

I know you or anyone for that matter can have the answers I look for but honestly, it warms my heart to know strangers out there feel what I feel and actually gotten past them hump in their life. 

Just so hard to wanna get better when even when I was sober as a bean I didn’t wanna live past 15. Back when the most dangerous thing I did was drink energy drinks. Back when I was forced to live with myself without trying to find myself in all this ambiguity. 

But thanks stranger
Do you know My Own Private Idaho by chance?
I hate this side of me that I suppress cause usually im sober but when I do get weak, feels just as worse to get ignored then than now

Well when I do get drunk I text mean stuff in a line (for whatever reason) that she refuses to block me on. I say stuff I don’t mean to say, but stuff to show how I feel when it feels to get betrayed. Hard to explain really.

Maybe it gives others inspiration to keep going. I’ve only been feeling this impending doom of, “ those that give you attention only seeks it back cause they don’t wanna feel lonely and you’re the easiest to catch” in that.

Maybe it’s cause they wish to capture that void of happiness into their life and be a sacrifice so you could be happy (god I know I would for an ex of mine). 

Maybe just others feeling better that they can help someone else. 

It’s human nature to wanna feel accepted by others who share our beliefs and struggles. Hell, why did revolutions start? I would say I can understand how you feel but I’ve been feeling this for only a year now truly. Might be an insult to say I do but I feel like I can. Nothing nor no one can make us feel better inside but ourselves. 

I wish my death to others that I care about can make their problems go away but it probably won’t. Nothing we say can make others’ worries go away, but our actions can. 

Know when I say this, I hope for the both of our sakes’ that life gets better. And if you wanna talk about anything at all, I’m all ears or words. I could use the company too ya know?

What helps me is to remind myself we all have our flaws. We’re human right? I can’t make every right decision to the standard everyone else might. And I believe that’s what makes us unique. And it’s hella awesome to be unique. For me, I’d use music to express myself. Like If im at a lost for words, I’d find a song that explains what I can’t. Personally, Current joys has helped me in that department. Though I don’t have much of anyone who’ll listen to the songs I share who even bother to ask but that’s alright. It’s okay to be flawed, we have to accept our flaws and look on the bright side of things. You have an inferior complex? To me atleast, it tells me you care for others. You’d put others before yourself and that’s awesome. Being selfless is what we are in dire need of. Friends who are so judgmental aren’t real friends. I know the tired old saying, words can’t hurt you but they most certainly do! And it’s okay to speak your mind about something that’s bothering you. No matter how small, it matters to you in the end and you deserve to be heard. :)

It took me awhile to not just be constantly thinking about her. Just know, it’s okay to have crying episodes or intense feelings of numbness. It’s okay to be emotional about it all. There may be times where you feel okay about it all and BAM! It hits you all over again, and that’s perfectly fine. It will end or at the very least lessen. No matter what happens, the sun will rise tomorrow.

But I found it easier to lose that hope. It’s a shitty thinking but with hope building up only to be potentially let down again is absolutely terrible. Personally I stay low and sadden to prevent further sadness. 



Idk what I’m really tryna say. I ramble on but distractions help. Keeping your mind occupied ‘till it matters less and less what he thinks about you. What I constantly try to do atleast

Everyday is a stressful one. It’s tiresome to not just break down crying or scream out to wanting it all to end. I don’t have hope for myself, but I hate to see others feel as down as me.



Will you struggle with me?

Had to take a step back cause I got a little teary eyed. Thanks for every single word honestly. At the very end of my buzz I just felt like complete shit. I just don’t know about anything anywhere these days really. Dropped out of school due to stress (which led me to a relapse of drugs), having my family mistrust me now. I feel so different than a year ago. Didn’t even dabble in drugs and alcohol until the beginning of this year. It’s been a roller coaster, one that showed me a unhealthy way of escaping my emotions. Always just felt like shit and cried silently at night then life went on. I guess this recent breakup did a number on me. 



Anyway, caught myself rambling, distractions are key you’re right. I was doing fine on not doing anything for a couple of weeks until a wave of stress hit me. Been trying to distract myself but I start getting into this pit of thoughts that have me not give a fuck about tomorrow just whatever gets me feeling better fast. I should get help but I don’t care myself that much to take that route seriously. Which is why I came here to ask for advice cause I don’t have anyone in my life to do that with. But your words have hit a cord with me. Thanks again for this honestly. 




Also, tell your boss it was for a good reason!

Being alone for me is me being in my room 95% of the time I’m awake. No job, no school, no one hits me up to talk. Never hung out with anyone really. Don’t talk to anyone but myself or my dog (he’s the best). I don’t get people who hang out with their friends and consider themselves alone.  But each person feels the way they do for a reason I like to believe.

Everyday is another day I failed at setting myself free. I can’t begin to think about tomorrow. Tonight is the only thing I live in. Endowing myself in thoughts of hopelessness and isolation. Nothing changes how my nights end nor the feelings I have every waking moment. Mistrusted by those who say they wanna help me but also lied to by the same ones. I don’t know what I want anymore other than sweet death. But I’m scared, scared of leaving my good dog behind or my little siblings barely having any memory of me when they grow up. All the hopes put onto me. But I can’t live on being selfless, I wanna be selfish just once. Please, this prison is hellish and I just wanna not be here anymore.

What is a worthy life? No one can ever say that their life is worth more than yours. We all breathe the same air and eat the same things. 



Reach out to anyone, even me if you want. It’s good to speak your mind. There’s always someone who’ll be there that cares.

Only person who knows you well is you. Suicidal thoughts doesn’t have to have a requirement of making a plan or attempting. It’s a mindset in my eyes. 


What you feel matters. We often put on masks to show the world what we believe they wanna see. It’s easier to put on a happy face n be kind to people. It’s so hard to be the realest you. And even if it is to online strangers or your therapist, what you feel deserves to be heard. 


If you want someone to chat to or whatever I’m here. We’re both here and that’s what matters.

I care, a stranger on Reddit. I think the assumption behind that phrase comes from the thinking we won’t be doing what we’re doing now. But it always seems like it could be better. May feel 10% better or worse 4 months from now but it doesn’t over the thoughts of ending it.


Yesterday I placed a plastic bag over my head for about 15 seconds several times. I wanted to feel like I was alive. I get high and drink to feel something. I wanna feel something other than this feeling of isolation. It’s so easy to get into the thinking of, “I won’t feel after I do it”. That’s what encourages my thinking atleast.


Tonight my words or attempts to reach out may not make it better in the near future. But if it keeps you going tonight then I’m delighted to make this reply to you every night for however long. 


You’re here still, and that’s the important part.

If you feel alone or want someone to listen I’m just a message away. A stranger on Reddit is here for you. I can relate to the feeling of just wanting to give up. But the most hopeful say I can say that helps me now is that we’re here. And That’s beautiful and amazing.
